theorem: The residual 144-square class has an actual order-576 paratopy point stabilizer, but that group is not the W33 order-576 minimum-vector stabilizer: their centers, derived subgroups and element-order censuses differ. Hence the canonical residual Latin-square bridge is ruled out at group level.
boundary: The result concerns the standard row/column/symbol/parastrophe action on labelled 4x4 Latin squares.
